notes: F1 hybrid Duradouro, one plant per stake, sprinkler irrigation, dark red latosol. Treatments are planting arrangements (tomato alone, coriander alone, tomato+coriander) in an organic and a conventional area, so no product dose applies to the rows. Conventional area got insecticides and fungicides in rotation 'em dosagens recomendadas' (imidaclopride, abamectina, buprofezina and others), no doses, count or method printed, p2-3. Organic: compost at planting plus topdressing; conventional: NPK 4-14-8 plus fortnightly topdressing. Maize and crotalaria borders; organic area surrounded by Tithonia diversifolia.
